# spc-cbg (PHAROS fixture)

CBG Geneesmiddeleninformatiebank, saved 6 November 2026, 23:40–00:08 Cairo.

* `metadata_excerpt.csv`: the header and five rows of `https://www.geneesmiddeleninformatiebank.nl/metadata.csv`
  (19,569 rows, 16.4 MB): RVG 117810 Carivalan, 117827 Prescoriel, 118269 Ivabradine Sandoz, 29078 Carvedilol
  Teva (no previous SmPC) and EU/1/05/316 Procoralan (centrally authorised, `SOORT` empty). `SOORT` is "RVG "
  with a trailing space, as published.
* `h117827_smpc.pdf`: `https://www.geneesmiddeleninformatiebank.nl/smpc/h117827_smpc.pdf`, the Prescoriel SmPC
  changed 30 April 2024.
* `h117827_smpc_20221202_v0005.pdf`: its previous version, from the CBG's archive (`SMPC_VORIGE_VERSIE`),
  stamped "Oude versie" across every page.
